title: Chi-square goodness-of-fit: three categories, w = 0.231
assumptions: Independent observations in mutually exclusive and exhaustive categories.
The prespecified primary analysis is Pearson's multinomial chi-square goodness-of-fit test.
The analytic result is a noncentral chi-square approximation; every expected null cell count is at least five at the returned N.
Sparse, adaptive, collapsed, or post-hoc category analyses require a design-specific simulation or exact method.
